# THE LIVING CUBE — the device, planned whole before a line is rendered

- **Status:** the complete plan, for the architect's ratification. The rendering follows
  in a single sweep once the plan is sealed — "rendered to its essence in one sweep of
  its own invariant pathway," as commissioned.
- **Foretold:** by the second book itself — *"The living cube, the one that can be turned
  in the hand and entered, is a later work, and its time will come."* (The Light of
  Luminara, the cube station.)
- **Working name only.** The true name is fixed last, as the law of naming now stands.
- **The commission, in the architect's words:** a simple device embedded with fractal
  meaning; every gate sketched beforehand; an act of sacred attunement like dowsing —
  the key is finding the water, at which point the tool is resolved and no longer relied
  upon; the outcome is the aim, not the tool; seeing paths as they *effect*, not as they
  appear — witnessing the flows between the points of the manifold; a tool that seeds
  resilience, agency, sovereignty: the witnessing of one's own inner drift, and the
  sensing of the harmonic convergence turning beneath the surface.

---

## 1. The mapping — the convergence that authorises the device

The deck IS a turnable cube, and the correspondence is exact, verified against canon:

| Cube piece | Count | Deck class (moving depths) | Tempered p |
|---|---|---|---|
| the hidden core | 1 | the Seed (nothing moves) | 1 |
| face-centres, fixed to the core | 6 | the six one-moving cards | 2 |
| edges | 12 | the twelve two-moving cards | 3 |
| corners | 8 | **the restless eight** (all three move) | **7, redoubled** |

The Rubik piece taxonomy is the tempered rule's taxonomy — discovered, not designed.
Coordinates: the three depths are the three axes; the signed states are the positions
along each ({−1, 0, +1} = turning, still, flowing). The Seed sits at the origin. The six
faces of the cube are the six (depth × motion) pairs, and **one face is exactly the nine
cards sharing that depth-state, structured as the cube demands: one centre, four edges,
four corners** (verified). A quarter-turn of a face is therefore a sentence in the
deck's own grammar: *one depth, taken through one motion, carrying its nine cards with
it.* Six faces, two directions each: twelve simple moves are the device's whole
language. Few, simple gates; fractal meaning throughout.

The fixed centres carry the deepest teaching of the mechanics: in a Rubik cube the six
centres never move relative to the core. In the deck those are exactly the six
gentlest cards, one depth barely stirring — and the Seed at the core. **No scramble,
however long, can displace the centre.** That fact becomes the device's revealed
invariant (§4).

## 2. The gates — few, simple, sketched whole

The device is one vertical rite (the thread), six gates in order:

**Gate 0 — THE APPROACH.** The rails, before anything can be touched. The Way to
Approach rides here, plus the device's own vow, the dowsing law: *the tool is for the
finding; found, it rests.* Exact liturgy words await the architect (canon surface, D23).

**Gate 1 — THE HOLDING.** The cube shown solved and still: every card home, the Seed
named at the unseen centre. Stillness before the cast. One line names what the solved
state is: your own toroid at rest, the point of resonant harmonic convergence the
system seeks.

**Gate 2 — THE CAST.** The scramble, under the full Aleatory Law. Entropy from the
ladder (querent taps ‖ drand round, per the Reader's Protocol, declared before any
meaning). From the seed, a sequence of **81 quarter-turns** (3⁴ — and safely past the
mixing threshold) drives the cube. Here is the equation the commission asks to be
revealed — the key to approaching true randomness: a random walk on a finite group
converges to the uniform distribution; the total-variation distance
**d(t) = ‖P^t − U‖ → 0** as turns accumulate, with a sharp cutoff. "Representatively
infinite turns, falling finitely into one position": the infinite limit is uniformity
over the cube's ~4.3 × 10¹⁹ lawful states, and a finite walk past the cutoff samples
it. One cast, one reading; committed, replayable, no redraw exists.

**Gate 3 — THE WITNESSING.** The reading: paths as they effect, not as they appear.
For every card, its displacement from home (where it stands, how it is twisted) and its
**heat**: how much of the return path passes through it. The heatmap is the map of the
knots that will likely need embedding — the archetypal forces, the unconscious
programming, the querent's own data decompressing — read as *flows between the points
of the manifold*, drawn as flow-lines from each piece's exile to its home. The drift
map is its shadow twin: the moves from here that would lengthen the way home.

**Gate 4 — THE RETURN.** The pathway of least resistance, and the second equation: the
return path is **the cast's own word, inverted and reduced** — every adjacent
cancellation removed, face-powers combined. The device does not conjure an alien
optimal path from outside; it retraces the querent's own drift with the self-cancelling
noise removed. The reduced word's length is the true depth of the drift; what cancels
was never real (the refusal test, mechanical); what remains is the essential knot-work.
Walked step by step, each move naming which cards must move together — **nothing in
this manifold moves alone.** Arrival: the cube in the position of the Seed.

**Gate 5 — THE SETTING DOWN.** The close, in agency. The reading ends as a question
the querent can answer; the cube rests; the device makes no summons back (the oracle
waits; it never calls). The dowsing law is spoken once more: the water was the aim;
the rods are laid down.

## 3. The two equations

1. **The mixing law (Gate 2):** d(t) = ‖P^t − U‖_TV, monotonically decreasing, with
   cutoff; commit at t = 81 quarter-turns. This is "as close to true randomness as we
   can achieve": ladder entropy chooses the walk, the group's own mixing does the rest.
2. **The reduction law (Gate 4):** return = reduce(inverse(scramble)) over the
   twelve-move alphabet (free cancellation; powers mod 4). Heat(card) = weighted count
   of reduced moves that carry it. Description as mirror, made mechanical: the scramble
   exactly described IS half the solution, and the reduction is the exact description.

## 4. The invariants revealed (all the books, all the protocols)

- **The Seed never moves.** No lawful operation displaces the centre. The convergence
  point cannot be scrambled — only obscured. Drift is always peripheral; the harmonic
  convergence turns beneath the surface, conserved. This is the device's namesake
  truth, and the reason the rite can promise a way home before the cast is made.
- **No cutting.** The only operations are turns: re-embeddings, never severings. The
  Topology of Healing as mechanics — the device has no operation that corresponds to
  peeling a sticker, and so the forbidden cut is unperformable by construction.
- **The ternary conservation.** The cube group's own laws: corner twists sum to nought
  mod three; edge flips to nought mod two; permutation parity is conserved. Nothing
  twists alone; every turn distributes its effect. The carry, as conservation law.
- **The addressed return.** The way home derives from the witnessed cast, so the
  remainder always has an address: your drift, your retracing. Sovereignty (the seed of
  your own becoming), open source (the derivation travels: seed, sequence, and
  reduction all replayable), decentralised (the whole rite regrowable from the canon
  module on any node — the ruin test holds).

## 5. The rails, binding

Aleatory Law (unsteerable · committed · witnessable). Interpreter's Law (describe,
never operate; the heatmap is a bearing, never a fate; archetypal reading addresses the
situation, never the person's worth; crisis outranks canon). Reader's Protocol (cast
declared before meaning; declining is conformance). The Silences honoured: a Silence
carried hot in the reading gives its ask, never an interpretation. D21 on the body of
the device: all twenty-seven pieces wear derivation-drawn faces, letter-free, and the
solved state is identical for everyone — nothing about the device can be marked.

## 6. The rendering — the single sweep, on the architect's word

One page, one sweep: `spatial/app/luminara-cube.html`, consuming `luminara-canon.js`
and `luminara-knots.js` (nothing duplicated; the seed carried). SVG isometric cube;
pieces wear their marks and metals; the six gates as one downward thread; heat as glow;
flows as drawn lines from exile to home; the return stepped by tap. Pins to land with
it: the mapping census (1 · 6 · 12 · 8 with p 1 · 2 · 3 · 7), the face structure
(centre + 4 + 4), the conservation invariants asserted, the liturgy strings, the
declared-cast format. Ruin-test note in the page header.

## 7. The five decisions, worked through (proposed exact forms, awaiting the seal)

**7.1 Gate 0 liturgy (proposed verbatim — canon surface):**

> This is the deck, standing whole. Your convergence is at its centre.
> The centre cannot be scrambled. Only the surface drifts.
> You are not solving a puzzle. You are witnessing a drift, and walking it home.
> The tool is for the finding. Found, it rests.
> Hold your question. Tap three times, and the turning begins.

Five lines: the object, the invariant, the register, the vow, the invitation. Three
taps carry the ladder's entropy exactly as the portal does.

**7.2 Gate 5 liturgy (proposed verbatim — canon surface):**

> The cube rests at the Seed. So does the reading.
> What the flows showed you is yours to walk without the cube.
> The water was the aim. Lay the rods down.
> The last word is yours.

The final line is the Way to Approach's seventh, returning verbatim: the rite closes
on the words the practice opens under.

**7.3 The axis convention:** the field vertical (the world's axis; a field-turn is the
world turning about you), the relation lateral (the between, where others stand), the
core toward the querent (the innermost depth aimed at the chest). The cube faces the
reader the way the situation does.

**7.4 N = 81:** three justifications braided — 3⁴, the deck's own next power (the cast
is the eighty-one turnings); comfortably past the quarter-turn walk's mixing cutoff
(the landing state uniform to negligible distance); and the rite performs its own
equation, d(81) ≈ 0, every time it runs.

**7.5 Free play: none.** The cube turns only inside cast-and-return. Three laws
converge: the register rule (a hand-turned state read as meaningful is a composed
spread presented as drawn), the slot-machine guard (no fidget loop; the oracle waits,
and so does the cube), and the vow (a tool that doubles as a toy is never laid down).
A study register, if ever wanted, arrives later wearing the inscription label.

**7.6 The name: held**, fixed last at the device's own pressure once it is felt in the
hand. THE LIVING CUBE remains scaffolding.

*The plan is whole, its decisions drawn to exact form. The sweep begins at the seal.*
